{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44019089/3bf93ab8f665b81ea067a7b14b6e83e17eb9883d.png

This is a small update with some QOL fixes for the Steam Deck experience.

If you run into any issues, bugs or crashes, please let me know in the Discord server, or email support@ruairidx.com.

notes.title: 1.1 Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
The 1.1 update, Bang Average Football's first major content update since launch, is now available for everyone! 🥳⚽️

This update adds a ton of new content for new and old players.



 🏆 Tournaments mode: combine league divisions, cups and knockouts in any mix of teams and settings to construct and conquer your own competitions outside of Story mode. Throw all your teams into one giant megaleague or relive your favourite tournament from years gone by.


 📗 More Story mode: revisit Story mode and discover an expanded sponsorship system and a whole new competition to conquer: the King's Cup! Win all 5 trophies for a new alternate ending...


 🎨 Custom content: you can now create and share your own bespoke, handmade content! Databases can be filled with custom players and teams for Tournaments and Quick Matches. In-game players can also be decked out in custom hairstyles and facial hair to add even more variety and personalisation to your Story mode hero, or any other player who needs a new look! Learn more!


 🛠️ Steam Workshop: all of your databases, hairstyles and facial hair designs can be shared with the world with Steam Workshop!



Naturally, there's also a few new achievements for you to chase down while you're getting stuck into the new content. Time to get hunting!

If you run into any issues, bugs or crashes, please let me know in the Discord server, or email support@ruairidx.com.

Ruairi

[hr][/hr] 

EDIT 2025-06-27: for those asking about using 1.0 Story save files in 1.1: save files started in 1.0 (annotated with a small red 'v1.0' banner in the file select screen) will get the classic Story mode experience, and not the new 1.1 Story mode. Ultimately, it became too complicated to add 1.1 content to 1.0 saves without introducing sequence breaks or risking missing the new content altogether.

If you're starting again for 1.1, you can progress through the early parts much quicker by simulating matches on Easy difficulty; the game won't penalise you for this and you can reset those settings mid-Story once you're caught up and playing matches again.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.12
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to announce that Bang Average Football now has Latin American Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese localisations (by humans, not ChatGPT)! // Estoy muy emocionado de anunciar que Bang Average Football ahora tiene localizaciones en español latinoamericano y portugués brasileño (hechas por humanos, no por ChatGPT). // Estou muito animado para anunciar que o Bang Average Football agora tem localizações em espanhol latino-americano e português brasileiro (feitas por humanos, não pelo ChatGPT)!

The first time you run this version, you'll be asked to select your preferred language. You won't be asked again the next time you run the game (or any time after), but you can change the language again from the Settings menu (Ajustes // Configurações).

Full list of changes:


 Improvement: Full support for Spanish (Latin America),
 Improvement: Full support for Portuguese (Brazilian).
 Improvement: Additional support for special characters.
 Bugfix: game sporadically crashes on Windows during first Horston cutscene.


If you run into any issues, bugs or crashes, please let me know in the Discord server, or email support@ruairidx.com. ¡Diviértanse! / Divirtam-se!

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Massive thanks to everyone who has bought and played Bang Average Football so far! This is a small update with some quality-of-life tweaks and fixes based on early feedback.


 Easy & Medium difficulties rebalanced slightly. Your own team's stats will be slightly boosted on these difficulties. This should help make it easier to score at the beginning of Story mode when your team is horrendous.
 Added dedicated Shift + Caps Lock keys to on-screen keyboard, and added a page of special unicode characters.
 Camera position in replay GIFs is interpolated more to prevent unpleasant jerking and twitching.
 Fixed a typo in some Story mode dialogue.


If you run into any issues, bugs or crashes, please let me know in the Discord server, or email support@ruairidx.com.

Ruairi
